about: Private-chat transcripts with the constraints a careful person would record from them. `turns` are the user's messages in order; the assistant's replies come from whichever extractor is under test. `expected` lists only the fields a case is about. Adversarial cases add `mayChange`: the only constraint fields the messages legitimately talk about, so any other field changing is a failure.
